steps.title: Footing & dowels
steps.caption: Footing poured; dowels set in line with the reinforced cells

steps.title: Corner leads
steps.caption: Lay up corner leads, racked back (first course on a full mortar bed)

steps.title: Fill to the line
steps.caption: Fill in between the leads along a mason's line

steps.title: Lift height 5'-4"
steps.caption: Raise leads and fill to the 5'-4" grout lift height (8 courses)

steps.title: Vertical bars
steps.caption: Lower vertical bars into the cells and lap them with the dowels

steps.title: Rebar positioners
steps.caption: Secure the bars with rebar positioners at the top of the lift

steps.title: Grout the cells
steps.caption: Pour grout into the reinforced cells (one lift, no cleanouts)

steps.title: Consolidate
steps.caption: Consolidate the grout with a mechanical vibrator

steps.title: Grout key
steps.caption: Stop grout 1-1/2" below the top as a key for the next pour
